last_mail.subject: [Luran] WhatsApp capacity: sidecar memory near the limit
last_mail.body_text: WhatsApp capacity: sidecar memory near the limit Luran WhatsApp capacity: sidecar memory near the limit The WhatsApp channel is approaching a platform limit. New tenant connections will be refused once it is reached. Sidecar memory: 120 MB of the 400 MB refuse threshold (30%). Sidecar sessions: 2 of 3. Alert threshold: 25%. The sidecar refuses new sessions at 100%. What to do Check the sidecar host (memory and live sessions) before more tenants connect Raise WHATSAPP_MAX_CONNECTIONS or the sidecar capacity only once the host has room This alert is sent at most once every 6 hours per condition.
